description: NaSi crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Si¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Si bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.29 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Si¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Si bond distances ranging from 2.99-3.38 Å. There are two inequivalent Si¹⁻ sites. In the first Si¹⁻ site, Si¹⁻ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and three Si¹⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Si-Si bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.41 Å. In the second Si¹⁻ site, Si¹⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and three Si¹⁻ atoms. The Si-Si bond length is 2.45 Å.
